title: guntis-vitolins-metamask-8-6eth: lead 1 executed, on-screen text read (122 dictionary words, 109 new; coin words atom/link/basic/token/dash)
body:
Lead 1 in `analysis/leads.md` ("read the text shown on screen in the challenge video") is executed. Method: `yt-dlp` of w4mpiuBP_aY at 720p, `ffmpeg` frames at 1 fps (431 frames), macOS Vision OCR on every frame, tokens intersected with the BIP-0039 English list, then diffed against `data/reading-order-pool.json` (+ anchors, fiber, fork). Date: 2026-09-04. No derivations were run for this issue; it is a word-identification result only.

**Result: 122 distinct dictionary words are legible on screen, 109 of them absent from every written surface in the pool.** So the on-screen channel is real and the pool used by every sweep in `analysis/tested.md` was incomplete.

Most of the 109 are browser chrome (YouTube sidebar, Brave banner, CryptoCompare UI). The words that match the "portfolio table" prediction in lead 1 are the coin names actually shown (the table lists Ethereum, Monero, Chainlink, NEO, Basic Attention Token, Cardano, Cosmos, IOTA, Synthetix, Tezos), which yield: **atom, link, basic, token**, plus **dash** from the CryptoCompare coin list. Of the other coin words named in lead 1 (cash, icon, wave, gas, ocean, fetch, ripple) none is legible at 1 fps / 720p, also not after 2x upscaling of the table segment (93 s to 201 s), and none is spoken. `cloud` is not on screen anywhere, which supports established fact 3 (`fog`).

A second channel that no sweep row uses: the words **spoken** in the challenge video. YouTube's auto captions contain 129 dictionary words, 110 not in the written pool. Given that hints 4 and 5 were delivered by voice, this may matter. Spoken-only words: able about all already another autumn because before believe best better body call can chase check child come cost course crazy current decide donor end enjoy example exchange find gain give good have head heart hold hope human hundred increase into jump just key kind know language lend make market material matter minimum miss moment month move much music myself next nice now old one only open other over point position possible present price purchase right run say scene screen seven since six soon start stay still success such talk ten thank that they time today trade try twenty two until very want way what when where win worth year.

Files (frame list, per-word frame indexes, the transcript intersection) are reproducible from the method above; happy to attach the JSON if useful. I am running the RO1 model extended with the 5 coin words as free-floating video-side words (k_coin in {1,2}) and will report the count and witness result as a `tested.md` PR when it finishes.
